dossier.scp_unleashed.105.title: Iris
dossier.scp_unleashed.105.caption: SCP-105 as first sighted, photographing wildflowers in an open field.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-105 is cooperative and is to be housed in a furnished humanoid cell with a window. She may keep her camera at all times. Photographs she produces are to be logged and sealed until they have been reviewed.
Staff may speak with SCP-105 freely. She is not to be photographed without her consent. **Photographs given to staff by SCP-105 are not to be examined in confined spaces.**

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-105 is a young woman of slight build with fair skin, blue eyes and shoulder-length blonde hair. She dresses plainly, usually in a black T-shirt, jeans and canvas sneakers, and calls herself Iris.

She wears an old instant camera on a leather strap around her neck and photographs almost everything she sees: animals, passers-by, objects left lying in the sun. She is friendly, talkative and easily distracted.
SCP-105 does not attack anyone and keeps her distance from anything hostile. Injuries she sustains heal unusually quickly.
Now and then SCP-105 gives one of her photographs to a person she has been talking with. These photographs are faded and hard to make out at a glance. %rDATA EXPUNGED%r

page.title: Addendum 105-1: Recovery
text: SCP-105 was found in open country on a clear day, photographing a patch of wildflowers. She came with the recovery team willingly and asked only whether she could keep her camera.
She has only been met after this file has been opened, and always somewhere open to the sky.

page.title: Addendum 105-2: Incident Note
text: Agent %rMarsh%r was handed a photograph by SCP-105 during a routine interview. He described it as "just a sheep in a field" and was later found in the observation room with %rsomething that bleated%r.

SCP-105, "Iris": a friendly young woman with blonde hair and an old instant camera on a strap around her neck. She is Safe-class and never attacks anyone.
She does not occur naturally. Once her archive file has been read, she turns up somewhere nearby in the open.
She stays close to where she was found, takes pictures of whatever catches her eye and keeps well away from monsters.
She likes company. Stop and talk to her now and then.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp105_photograph: An instant photograph taken by SCP-105. She hands them to people she likes, now and then.
The pictures are faded and hard to make out at a glance.
Staff report that these photographs do not last long once they have been studied closely.

archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp105.0: Reports describe a young woman with a camera.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp105.1: She is met in open, daylit places.

message.scp_unleashed.scp105.line.0: Oh! Hi there. Hold still a second... perfect.
message.scp_unleashed.scp105.line.1: The light around here is lovely right now.
message.scp_unleashed.scp105.line.2: I never go anywhere without my camera.
message.scp_unleashed.scp105.line.3: Sorry, I take pictures of everything. Old habit.
message.scp_unleashed.scp105.line.4: You have a nice face for photos, you know.
message.scp_unleashed.scp105.line.5: This camera is older than I am. It still works, though.
message.scp_unleashed.scp105.line.6: I like photographing ordinary things. They're never quite ordinary.
message.scp_unleashed.scp105.line.7: Some of my pictures come out a little strange. I keep them anyway.
message.scp_unleashed.scp105.line.8: If you spot anything pretty around here, tell me!
message.scp_unleashed.scp105.line.9: Smile! ...Okay, you can stop smiling now.
message.scp_unleashed.scp105.gift.0: Here, I took this one for you. Have a look!
message.scp_unleashed.scp105.gift.1: Oh, this one came out nicely. You should keep it.
message.scp_unleashed.scp105.gift.2: Hold on, I have something for you... there.
...%s on a wooden shelf, a little out of focus.
...%s in the grass, right in the middle of the frame.
message.scp_unleashed.scp105.scene.hosti: ...%s standing in the dark, very close to the lens.
...%s behind a tree. It's looking right at me.
...%s. It's closer than it should be.
